name: A2 A-share integer-share execution validation before forward refit
unfilled_order_policy: One observed opening execution attempt on each scheduled rebalance session. Unfilled lots/limit/halt orders expire; retain actual holdings until the next scheduled signal. No daily reweighting or replacement using future availability.
dividend_tax_policy: Conservative fixed 20% reserve on cash plus separately evidenced taxable stock-dividend face value; exclude evidenced non-taxable share-premium capital reserves. Reserve is taken from cash distribution, and insufficient or unknown tax evidence stops posting. Not an exact holding-period tax statement.
corporate_action_tail_policy: Floor delivered integer shares; keep non-tradable fractional residual claims separately and report NAV lower/estimated/upper bounds. Never invent ChinaClear random tail allocation or cash-in-lieu.
execution_policy: Signal at prior source close; orders at next observed historical open. Reject limit-up buys and limit-down sells, unknown rules or missing execution metadata; enforce board lots, T+1, cash and minimum commissions. Never use same-day high/low to select a convenient fill.
new_listing_policy: Recognize the relevant first-five-session unbounded regime but conservatively do not initiate trades there without sufficient execution evidence.
source_policy: New immutable full-security repairs selected solely by strict data failures; separate real raw preclose/isST/trading-status/IPO metadata and corporate-action originals. No silent source or adjustment-mode relabeling.
model_policy: Keep the official Alpha158 and fixed LightGBM specification. Refit historical evaluation only because the repaired data vintage changed; never fit or stop on final OOS. Preserve A1 outputs.
forward_policy: Only after validation, independently refit the same parameters using the latest mature labels. Freeze a new model and current-member evidence; start with isolated paper cash after the actual freeze time. Prospective fills use fresh observed market quotes, never a past opening price; no broker orders.
